blind_spots: Only checks JSON parseability, not Draft 2020-12 structural conformance (lib/schema/validator_test.go covers that via Go).
Requires python3 in PATH; CI ubuntu-latest has it preinstalled — local devs without python3 see verdict=error rather than fail.
description: On any change touching schemas/, parses schemas/sensor.json and schemas/signal.json with python3 to confirm both files are syntactically valid JSON; regulates maintainability. Output is single because the python check is binary — exit 0 means both files parse, anything else means one of them is malformed and the python traceback is in stderr. Auto-detected via /detect-sensors from .github/workflows/test.yml.

execution.command: python3 -c 'import json; json.load(open("schemas/sensor.json"))' && python3 -c 'import json; json.load(open("schemas/signal.json"))'

name: Schema files parse as JSON

golden_cases.notes: python3 json.load on a well-formed JSON file exits 0 → exit_code_map[0] = pass/info.
Bare comment + unquoted version literal — python raises JSONDecodeError, exit non-zero → exit_code_map['*'] = fail/high.
